    SELECT [p].[Id], [p].[Name], [p].[Description], [p].[Price], [p].[IsActive], [p].[CategoryId]
    FROM [Products] AS [p]
    WHERE [p].[IsActive] = CAST(1 AS bit)
) AS [p0] ON [c].[Id] = [p0].[CategoryId]
ORDER BY [c].[Id] DESC

SELECT [c].[Id], [c].[Name], [c].[Description], [c].[IsActive], [p0].[Id], [p0].[Name], [p0].[Description], [p0].[Price], [p0].[IsActive]
FROM [Categories] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p].[Id], [p].[Name], [p].[Description], [p].[Price], [p].[IsActive], [p].[CategoryId]
    FROM [Products] AS [p]
    WHERE [p].[IsActive] = CAST(1 AS bit)
) AS [p0] ON [c].[Id] = [p0].[CategoryId]
ORDER BY [c].[Id] DESC

SELECT [c].[Id], [c].[Name], [c].[Description], [c].[IsActive], [p0].[Id], [p0].[Name], [p0].[Description], [p0].[Price], [p0].[IsActive]
FROM [Categories] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p].[Id], [p].[Name], [p].[Description], [p].[Price], [p].[IsActive], [p].[CategoryId]
    FROM [Products] AS [p]
    WHERE [p].[IsActive] = CAST(1 AS bit)
) AS [p0] ON [c].[Id] = [p0].[CategoryId]
ORDER BY [c].[Id] DESC
